summary: Completed testing of P1 (Notification System) and P2 (Document Attachments for Bookings). All backend APIs pass (18/18 tests). Frontend VenueBookingsPage and ArtistBookingsPage both load and function correctly with accept/decline booking flow and document upload modals working.

issues: No dedicated /notifications page exists - notifications are shown via dropdown in header. This is acceptable UX but worth noting.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{venue_id}/requests - returns booking requests for venue (200 OK)
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/{booking_id} with status 'accepted' - accepts booking and creates notification
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/{booking_id} with status 'declined' - declines booking and creates notification
Backend: GET /api/notifications - returns user notifications including booking updates
Backend: GET /api/notifications/count - returns unread notification count
Backend: PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read - marks notification as read
Backend: POST /api/notifications/mark-read - marks all notifications as read
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/{booking_id} with venue_documents - uploads venue document to booking
Backend: PATCH /api/bookings/{booking_id} with artist_documents - uploads artist document to booking
Backend: GET /api/bookings/{booking_id} - returns booking with both venue and artist documents
Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{venue_id}/calendar - returns venue calendar events
Frontend: VenueBookingsPage loads and displays booking requests for venue users
Frontend: VenueBookingsPage shows filter tabs (Pending, Accepted, Declined, All) with counts
Frontend: VenueBookingsPage Accept button opens modal with booking details and message field
Frontend: VenueBookingsPage Accept flow creates notification for artist
Frontend: ArtistBookingsPage loads and displays bookings made by artist
Frontend: ArtistBookingsPage shows filter tabs (All, Pending, Confirmed, Declined) with counts
Frontend: ArtistBookingsPage shows venue response for accepted bookings
Frontend: Document upload modal works on ArtistBookingsPage for accepted bookings
Frontend: Notification badge shows unread count in header
critical_code_review_comments: Booking accept/decline flow properly creates notifications using create_notification helper
Document attachments correctly append to existing arrays (venue_documents, artist_documents)
VenueBookingsPage correctly checks user category before allowing access
Both pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Notification system is fully functional with create, read, mark-read, and bulk operations
seed_data_creation: Created test_venue_user (venue category) and test_artist_user (musician category) for testing. Created booking 'Test Concert Night' which was accepted during testing.

Notifications are displayed via dropdown in header (no dedicated page). Test users created: test_venue_user and test_artist_user with password TestPass123!. All booking CRUD operations, accept/decline flows, and document upload functionality verified working.
